craft_notes: Sthāyin: identity — she is the collision. Rows: definition lands last. Rejected: abstracting saṃghaṭṭa — killed: collision kept bodily. Read aloud: landing blow.

lines: Such this pair, its part-talk melted away: when so it is,
by rank and excellence, she herself is knowing clashing into outflow.
l4.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ yāmalam etad galitabhidāsaṃkathaṃ yadaiva tadā kramatāratamyayogāt saiva hi saṃvidvisargasaṃghaṭṭaḥ
